Broad graceful manta wings with a few beautiful warm ivory star-shaped markings embedded in the skin, pearl lavender belly, two small natural cephalic fins beside mouth, single coherent fish body, long slender trailing tail. Cute expressive eye, restrained friendly smile; no human features, clothing, jewels or accessories. Face SCREEN RIGHT in a clear side or side-three-quarter profile. The head, mouth and snout point to the right; the body and tail trail behind to the left. Show forward swimming toward the right, never backward swimming. Graceful nearly horizontal pose with both wings readable and fully within frame, no tightly curled tail. Whole subject occupies 82 percent of square canvas's long axis; safe transparent padding all around. Genuine transparent background, opaque body interiors with subtle translucent fin edges. NO checkerboard, background, detached glitter, glow clouds, labels, grid, border or watermark.
